evidence-check.scope: Native HTML fields, one metadata-only source and dated explicit decisions. Failed, redirected-to-lander and script-only responses do not verify product claims. All 40 directory descriptions match the saved API; no new catalog specification is imported.

reimport-check.scope: Importer leaves every tracked data byte unchanged. Offline refresh may update only generation/comparison timestamps and the digest of timestamp-bearing coverage.

limitations: This batch checks 40 further saved listing URLs; it does not establish completeness of the live competitor inventory. The source inventory remains dated November 1, 2026.
All 40 normalized detail descriptions match the saved raw API descriptions. This is source consistency, not independent validation of their claims.
37 decisions are recorded. Three parsed pages remain pending because the linked RobotAnno domains fail and a historical page returns 404, while Atlas Robotics serves only a script redirect.

AstroRinse is listed as an outdoor home-service robot, while the manufacturer classifies it as the AquaSense X filter-cleaning and charging station. The conflict is recorded without treating the dock as a mobile robot.
Aibo is described as a humanoid for retail under an unrelated publisher domain; Sony presents aibo as a companion pup. Exact directory hardware and provider identity remain unproven.
ADAM is listed under TGW and Pilz as well as Richtech. Existing catalog name mapping is retained as a candidate, but no provider, OEM or educational-deployment equivalence is established.
Aigen linked aigen.com returns only a script redirect. The current aigen.io portfolio supports company scope but does not select Element for this generic listing.
Nine new primary follow-ups remain open: ACME, TGW ADAM, Pilz ADAM, GrabaRobot, Aibo, Alice AI, ANYmal industrial claims, Brain Corp coverage and the malformed BALYO entry.
Directory descriptions and manufacturer marketing do not establish exclusive USPs, independent performance, current availability, delivered deployments or market leadership.
Catalog CSVs, primary product highlights, specification reviews and existing identity decisions remain byte-identical. No front-end build or browser test is required for this batch.
